project.name: osgi/foundation/seed-broker-testkit
project.description: Reusable test doubles for the seed-broker seam — chiefly RefusingCellar (a Cellar that THROWS on every access, the honest stand-in for a sow whose handler must NOT touch the cellar, so a stray read fails loud instead of NPE-ing on null or masking the breach with a silent empty) and InMemoryCellar. Used BOTH flat (core modules' src/test) AND in-container (a -test fragment passenger imports the package), so it is our own dual-realm library (embed; type=dual-realm): staged as a bundle exporting seed.broker.testkit AND kept flat in the host — a plain jar could serve only the flat side, leaving the in-container fragment's import with no exporter.
